summary.text: Zach Hall is the Libertarian candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 43, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Libertarian Party primary.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as retail management and his birthplace as Toledo.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia survey response, Zach Hall is a lifelong Ohioan and a long-time Kroger employee.
The response says he served as deputy campaign manager for the Roberto Torres for Mayor campaign and is active in the Barrows Street Block Watch Association.
It describes his platform as eliminating property taxes, ending qualified immunity for public officials and law enforcement, and protecting individual freedoms.
